language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language for Stave menus, settings and messages. Your prompts, files and AI responses are not translated.

windowBehavior.title: Window Behavior
windowBehavior.description: Control how the app handles the close shortcut.

confirmBeforeClose.title: Confirm Before Close
confirmBeforeClose.description: Show a confirmation dialog before closing the app with ⌘W / Ctrl+W when no tabs or tasks are open.

notificationSound.title: Notification Sound
notificationSound.description: Customize the success sound played when a task turn finishes.
notificationSound.enableDescription: Enable or mute the task completion sound.
notificationSound.presetDescription: Choose the synthesized tone used for task completion.
notificationSound.volumeDescription: Adjust playback level for the task completion sound.

attentionSound.title: Attention Sound
attentionSound.description: Customize the sound played when the AI asks you a question or requests permission and is waiting on you.
attentionSound.enableDescription: Play a sound when the AI needs your input or approval.
attentionSound.presetDescription: Choose the synthesized tone used when the AI needs you.
attentionSound.volumeDescription: Adjust playback level for the attention sound.

soundControls.sourceDescription: Use a built-in preset or upload your own audio file.
soundControls.customAudioDescription: Upload an audio file (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, WebM). Max {{maxKb}} KB.
soundControls.readFailed: Failed to read the audio file.
soundControls.previewCustomDescription: Play the uploaded audio once with the current volume.
soundControls.previewPresetDescription: Play the current preset once with the current volume.

desktopNotifications.title: Desktop Notifications
desktopNotifications.description: Show task completion, approval, input requests and run sign-offs through the operating system.

native.title: Native Notifications
native.description: Notify you when a task needs attention outside the active workspace.

signOffReminder.title: Run Sign-off Reminders
signOffReminder.description: A run waiting for your sign-off notifies once. Remind again, in one batched notification, after it has waited this long.

placement.title: Open Run Details In
placement.description: Where the toggle on the run line above the prompt opens the turn's tools, agents and to-dos. The run line itself stays above the prompt either way, and its panel button always opens the Task panel.

expanded.title: Open Run Details
expanded.description: Open the details when a run starts instead of showing the run line alone. Your toggle during a run lasts until that run ends.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Font sizes and families applied to the shared chat surface.

messageFontSize.title: Message Font Size
messageFontSize.description: Prose font size for chat messages. Line height scales proportionally.

codeFontSize.title: Code Font Size
codeFontSize.description: Font size for inline code and code blocks in chat messages.

fontFamily.title: Font Family
fontFamily.description: Base sans-serif font for the app UI and chat messages. Pick a preset or type any installed family. Falls back to the Korean font, then sans-serif.

monoFontFamily.title: Mono Font Family
monoFontFamily.description: Monospace font for inline code and code blocks in messages.

koreanFontFamily.title: Korean Font Family
koreanFontFamily.description: Fallback font for Korean (CJK) text in messages. Pretendard Variable is loaded by default.

infoPanelScale.title: Information Panel Scale
infoPanelScale.description: Zoom level for the workspace information panel. Affects text, icons, buttons, and spacing uniformly.

behavior.title: Behavior
behavior.description: Toggle chat features and display preferences.

reasoningExpansion.title: Reasoning Expansion
reasoningExpansion.description: Auto expands the reasoning trace while a turn is streaming, then collapses it again. Manual keeps it collapsed until you open it.

interimMessages.title: Show Interim Messages
interimMessages.description: Show pre-final assistant text segments between execution steps. Hidden by default to keep the final response cleaner.

turnRail.title: Show Conversation Turn Rail
turnRail.description: Show the turn navigator on the right side of conversations with multiple eligible responses.

composerControls.title: Composer Controls
composerControls.description: Choose where each prompt input control lives: pinned to the toolbar, tucked into the ⋯ tray, or off. You can also right-click the toolbar to edit this in place.

layout.title: Composer Layout
layout.description: Framed raises the input card and hangs four bars off it: the run and queue shelf above, workspace and runtime below, and the control shelves beside it. Classic is the previous stack, with every control in the toolbar row. A narrow composer falls back to Classic either way.

activeTurn.title: Active Turn
activeTurn.description: Control what happens when you send a follow-up while an assistant turn is still running.

midTurnSteering.title: Mid-Turn Steering
midTurnSteering.description: When off, follow-ups are queued until the current turn finishes. When on, supported providers can receive live steering messages.

keys.title: Active-Turn Keys
keys.description: Choose which Enter action steers into the live turn and which queues for later.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how the app resolves light and dark mode.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: Choose which workspace navigation surfaces appear in the left sidebar.

fleetView.title: Fleet View Shortcut
fleetView.description: Show the Fleet View entry in the sidebar header area.

view.title: Sidebar View
view.description: Repositories lists workspaces by where they live; Work queue groups every workspace by what it wants from you. The toggle in the sidebar header changes this too, so the sidebar reopens in whichever view you used last.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Opt-in animated accents. All motion honors your system Reduced Motion preference.

borderBeam.title: Border Beam
borderBeam.description: Animate a soft highlight around the prompt input and the active workspace row while a task is streaming. Style presets come from the border-beam library.

beamSize.title: Beam Size
beamSize.description: Library size preset. Choose between a full border glow, compact controls, or a bottom sweep.

beamColors.title: Beam Colors
beamColors.description: Library color palette. `Colorful` is a full rainbow sweep; `Ocean` and `Sunset` are cool and warm variants; `Mono` is grayscale.

beamStrength.title: Beam Strength
beamStrength.description: Controls the library `strength` prop without changing the wrapped content.

presets.title: Theme Presets
presets.description: Choose a Stave original or a curated palette inspired by popular editor themes. Presets override the base light / dark tokens; manual token tweaks below still take priority.

importTheme.help: Drop a .theme.json file to install a community theme. The JSON must include id, name, baseMode, and a tokens map.

designTokens.title: Design Tokens
designTokens.description: These are Stave's base light and dark tokens. Custom presets layer on top, and manual overrides below still win.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Base editor type and spacing defaults.

display.title: Display
display.description: Toggle editor line wrapping and chrome.

aiCompletions.title: AI Inline Completions
aiCompletions.description: Ghost-text code suggestions powered by Claude. Uses the Claude SDK with your local Claude auth when available, or falls back to the Anthropic API (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

enable.title: Enable AI Completions
enable.description: Shows AI-generated inline suggestions as you type. Press Tab to accept. Uses Claude Haiku for fast, low-cost completions.

languageServers.title: Repository Language Servers
languageServers.description: LSP-backed intelligence for TypeScript/JavaScript and Python. Uses Electron-managed stdio language-server sessions per active workspace.

enable.title: Enable LSP Runtime
enable.description: Uses Electron-managed stdio language-server sessions per active workspace. Keep this off if you only want Monaco's built-in syntax support.

typescript.title: TypeScript LSP Command
typescript.description: Leave empty to auto-discover `typescript-language-server` from PATH. Install via `npm i -g typescript-language-server typescript`. Handles .ts, .tsx, .js, and .jsx files.

python.title: Python LSP Command
python.description: Leave empty to auto-discover `pyright-langserver` or `basedpyright-langserver` from PATH. You can also point this at an absolute executable path.

enable.title: Enable ESLint
enable.description: Reads ESLint config from the opened repository and shows diagnostics in the editor. Requires ESLint installed in the repository's node_modules.

formatOnSave.title: Format on Save
formatOnSave.description: Automatically apply ESLint auto-fix when saving a file.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Tune readability for the integrated terminal.

session.title: Session & Sign-in
session.description: Control where Lens keeps website cookies and local browser storage. Saved account passwords are managed separately below.

repositoryProfile.label: Repository profile
repositoryProfile.description: Share Lens sign-in across workspaces for this repository.

workspaceIsolated.label: Workspace isolated
workspaceIsolated.description: Keep Lens sign-in separate for the active workspace.

toasts.selectWorkspace: Select a workspace before clearing Lens data.
toasts.invalidHost: Enter a valid host or URL.

agentActivity.title: Agent Activity
agentActivity.description: Choose how a hidden Lens session appears when an agent starts visual inspection or page interaction. Navigation, DOM reads, and diagnostics alone stay hidden.

splitRight.label: Show beside task
splitRight.description: Open Lens in a right split without taking focus from the task.

backgroundTab.label: Background tab
backgroundTab.description: Add a Lens tab without changing the visible task surface.

agentDecides.label: Agent decides
agentDecides.description: Keep agent sessions hidden until the agent explicitly presents one.

sourceMapping.title: Source Code Mapping
sourceMapping.description: Choose which strategies the element picker uses to help AI locate source files.

heuristic.title: Heuristic Search
heuristic.description: AI uses class names, text content, and IDs to search for source files via grep. Recommended for most repositories.

reactDebugSource.description: Extract exact file and line number from React fiber internals. Only works with dev builds that include @babel/plugin-transform-react-jsx-source (enabled by default in Vite React plugin, CRA, and Next.js dev).

visualComments.title: Visual Comments
visualComments.description: Control whether visual comment screenshots are used only as local UI context or also sent to the selected AI provider.

screenshots.title: Send screenshots as AI image context
screenshots.description: Off by default. When enabled, screenshots captured through visual comment are included with the next message so the AI can inspect the selected region.

developerMode.title: Developer Mode
developerMode.description: Control CDP-backed Lens actions such as screenshots, JavaScript evaluation, and agent page control. Approval prompts appear app-wide, even when the Lens panel is closed.

cdpTools.title: CDP Tools
cdpTools.description: Ask before the first CDP action for each host. Allow once is temporary; always allow saves the hostname below.

developerMode.hostHelp: Enter a hostname or URL. Ports and paths are ignored, so localhost covers localhost:3000, localhost:8899, and other localhost ports.
developerMode.noHosts: No hosts are pre-approved. The first CDP action will show an approval dialog.

siteAccess.title: Site Access
siteAccess.description: Restrict Lens navigation by hostname. Blocked hosts win over allowed hosts. Loopback targets are always allowed for navigation, but CDP actions still require approval above.

allowed.title: Allowed Hosts
allowed.description: One host per line. Leave empty to allow any host that is not blocked.

blocked.title: Blocked Hosts
blocked.description: One host per line. These hosts are blocked even when they also match the allow list.

routing.title: Model Routing
routing.description: Pick the default Claude and Codex models used for new turns. Stave falls back to its verified Codex baseline if the App Server catalog is unavailable.

claudeEffort.title: Claude Effort
claudeEffort.description: Default reasoning effort applied to new Claude turns.

codexEffort.title: Codex Effort
codexEffort.description: Default reasoning effort applied to new Codex turns.

utility.title: Utility AI
utility.description: Provider used for task names, route classification, commit messages, and prompt enhancement. Auto prefers Claude or Codex from the active task, then falls back through installed utility runners.

responseStyle.title: Response Style
responseStyle.description: Formatting guidance injected into every Claude and Codex turn. Controls how the model structures its answers — headings, bullet lists, conciseness, etc.

field.title: Response Formatting Rules
field.description: Appended to the system prompt (Claude) or injected as hidden developer instructions (Codex). Empty disables the injection.

prDescription.title: Pull Request Description
prDescription.description: Template used when Stave auto-generates a PR title and body from the branch diff.

field.title: PR Description Prompt
field.description: The instruction part of the prompt. Branch context (diff, commit log, file list) is appended automatically.

prCompletion.title: PR Completion
prCompletion.description: Controls the final steps after Stave creates a ready pull request.

autoMerge.title: Queue Auto-Merge
autoMerge.description: After the ready PR is created, queue the selected merge strategy using GitHub's configured checks.

mergeMethod.title: Merge Method
mergeMethod.description: Choose the strategy passed to GitHub when auto-merge is queued.

default.label: Repository default
default.description: Let GitHub choose the configured strategy or merge queue.

squash.label: Squash
squash.description: Combine the branch into one commit.

rebase.label: Rebase
rebase.description: Rebase and merge without a merge commit.

inlineCompletion.title: Inline Code Completion
inlineCompletion.description: System prompt for the FIM (fill-in-the-middle) code completion engine in the editor.

field.title: Completion System Prompt
field.description: Controls how the model generates code completions. Must instruct the model to output raw code only.

turnSummary.title: Workspace Latest Turn Summary
turnSummary.description: Automatically writes a short 'what the user asked / what the AI did' summary to the top of the Information panel after each completed turn. Its model lives in Settings → Background AI.

field.title: Summary Prompt
field.description: Instruction template for the Information panel's automatic latest-turn summary. Task title, latest user request, and latest assistant response are appended automatically. Empty disables automatic summaries.

tasks.title: Review Tasks
tasks.description: The composer's Review button runs a read-only review in its own task, beside the task you are working in. When it finishes, attach its findings to your next message.

defaultReviewer.title: Default Reviewer
defaultReviewer.description: The reviewer the dialog suggests. Other provider cross-checks the latest reply with the provider that did not write it. You can still pick any model when you start a review.

crossCheck.title: Cross-check With Both Providers
crossCheck.description: Start a second, independent review on the other provider with each review. You can still turn it off in the dialog.

modelField.description: Used when this provider reviews. The default follows the provider's model setting.

focus.title: Default Focus
focus.description: Focus areas selected when the dialog opens. Each adds an explicit instruction to the review.

skill.title: Review Skill
skill.description: A skill whose instructions every review follows, such as a team review checklist. Skills come from this workspace and your shared skills; a review cannot use one its reviewer cannot load.

instructions.title: Review Instructions
instructions.description: Added to every review prompt, for example risk areas your team always checks. Up to {{max}} characters.
instructions.placeholder: For example: check that new settings are persisted and covered by a test.

followUp.title: Follow-up Prompt
followUp.description: Filled into an empty message when you attach a finished review, so asking the task to act on it is one send away. Empty turns it off.

prePr.title: Pre-PR Review
prePr.description: Run a best-effort one-shot AI review before Stave pushes a branch and opens a pull request.

enable.title: Review Before Opening PR
enable.description: Shows concrete findings in the PR dialog with options to stop and fix or proceed anyway. Model failures never block PR creation.

provider.title: Review Provider
provider.description: Choose which provider runs the one-shot review. The provider uses its configured default model.

panel.intro: Review repository-specific workspace defaults, git metadata, scripts config, and removal actions for this repository.

metadata.notGitRepository: This repository folder is unavailable or is no longer a git repository.

appearance.title: Repository Appearance
appearance.description: Give each repository a stable visual identity across the sidebar and repository switcher.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Choose a shape that makes this repository recognizable at a glance.

color.title: Color
color.description: Color applies to the repository icon while the surrounding surface follows the active theme.

settings.title: Repository Settings
settings.description: Repository-specific defaults, git metadata, and list management for this repository.

instructions.title: Repository Instructions
instructions.description: Prepended to every Claude and Codex turn for this repository. Use it for repo-specific guardrails, tooling preferences, and workflow rules.
instructions.placeholder: Prefer bun over npm. Preserve existing Zustand selector stability patterns. Keep documentation in sync with user-facing changes.

postCreateCommand.title: Post-Create Command
postCreateCommand.description: Runs once in the new workspace root after creation. Useful for `bun install`, `npm install`, or multi-line bootstrap commands.

kickoffBranchNaming.title: Kickoff Branch Naming Rule
kickoffBranchNaming.description: Included in workspace kickoff resolution for this repository. Use it to encode repository-specific prefixes, ticket conventions, or casing rules.
kickoffBranchNaming.placeholder: Use feat/<jira-key>-<short-description> for feature work and fix/<jira-key>-<short-description> for bugs.

rootNodeModules.title: Reuse Root node_modules
rootNodeModules.description: Creates `node_modules` in each new worktree as a symlink to the repository root install. Faster startup, but later installs in that workspace will modify the shared dependency tree.
rootNodeModules.toggleHint: The symlink exists only inside the created workspace, so deleting the workspace leaves the repository root untouched.

remove.title: Remove repository
remove.description: Removes this repository from Stave's registered repository list without deleting files on disk.

workspaceTools.title: Workspace Tools
workspaceTools.description: One-shot commands, long-running processes, lifecycle triggers, and execution environments for this repository.
workspaceTools.footer: Configure and run them from the dedicated Workspace Tools section.

empty.title: No Repositories Yet
empty.description: Open a repository from the sidebar to register it here.
empty.body: Registered repositories will show their repository defaults and metadata in this section.

noSelection.title: Repository Details
noSelection.description: Choose a repository from the Settings sidebar to open its settings panel.
noSelection.body: Pick a repository from the sidebar to inspect its workspace defaults and repository metadata.

removeDialog.title: Remove Repository
removeDialog.description: Remove "{{name}}" from Stave's repository list? This does not delete files on disk.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Control skill suggestions and automatic prompting.

sharedRoot.title: Shared Skills Root
sharedRoot.description: Optional shared global skill directory. Leave blank to follow STAVE_SHARED_SKILLS_HOME when present. Supports ~/...

detected.title: Detected Skills
detected.description: Stave scans global, user, and workspace-local skill roots. The shared global root follows Settings first, then STAVE_SHARED_SKILLS_HOME.
detected.noRoots: No skill roots were discovered for the current workspace.

behavior.title: Behavior
behavior.description: Pinned commands appear first, hidden commands stay out of the palette, and recent history can be shown as its own section.

shellChords.title: Shell Shortcut Chords
shellChords.description: Keep panel and navigation shortcuts on a single Cmd/Ctrl+K prefix so they do not collide with editor and IDE bindings.
shellChords.conflictNote: Assigning a key moves it off any conflicting shell command automatically.

composerShortcut.title: Composer Shortcut
composerShortcut.description: Choose the shortcut that stages the current prompt text as a comment instead of sending it.

stageComment.title: Stage Comment
stageComment.description: The staged comment appears under the composer and is merged into the next sent prompt.

lensShortcut.title: Lens Shortcut
lensShortcut.description: Choose the shortcut that toggles Lens visual comment mode.

visualComment.title: Visual Comment
visualComment.description: The shortcut turns visual comment picking on or off while Lens is available.

modelShortcuts.title: Model Shortcuts
modelShortcuts.description: Map Alt+1..0 to prompt models and optional effort overrides. These shortcuts switch the active task provider and draft model immediately.
modelShortcuts.selectionWithCurrentEffort: Currently selects {{model}} on {{provider}} with the current effort setting.
modelShortcuts.noModel: No model assigned. The shortcut stays inactive until you set one.

visibility.title: Command Visibility
visibility.description: Pin the core actions you use most, or hide the ones you never want in the global palette.

contributors.title: Programmatic Contributors
contributors.description: The palette is backed by a registry so internal modules can add commands without coupling to the dialog component.
contributors.body: Use registerCommandPaletteContributor() to inject additional commands. Core Stave commands are customizable here; dynamic workspace/task entries and future contributed commands inherit the same execution surface automatically.

providerTimeout.title: Provider Timeout
providerTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a Claude or Codex runtime response before showing a timeout error.
providerTimeout.windowDescription: Default is 12 hours so long-running coding turns, refactors, and tool-heavy sessions do not time out too early.

codexBinary.title: Codex Binary
codexBinary.description: Override the path to the local `codex` binary. Leave empty to use the system install discovered from your PATH/home bin locations.
codexBinary.baselineBody: Stave targets the Codex App Server path in local `codex` CLI `{{version}}`. Older binaries may work for existing features, but newly adopted controls must be capability-gated. Update Codex or point this field at the version you want Stave to use.

claudeBinary.title: Claude Binary
claudeBinary.description: Override the path to the local `claude` binary. Leave empty to let Stave auto-select the newest working Claude install it can resolve.
claudeBinary.note: Use this when the shell `claude` auth state and Stave's Tooling panel disagree, or when multiple Claude installs exist on the same machine.

claudeRuntime.title: Claude Runtime Tools
claudeRuntime.description: Inspect current Claude session/workspace context pressure and refresh plugin-driven commands without leaving Stave.
claudeRuntime.contextLoadFailed: Failed to load Claude context usage.

debugLogging.title: Provider Debug Logging
debugLogging.description: Enables verbose stream event logging for all providers in the Electron main-process console.

gpu.title: GPU Acceleration
gpu.description: Electron-reported compositor status for diagnosing WSL2 and filtered transparency performance.

localMcp.title: Local MCP Server
localMcp.description: Manage the packaged-app loopback MCP endpoint used by same-machine bots and helpers.
localMcp.descriptionWithOptIn: Manage the packaged-app loopback MCP endpoint used by same-machine bots and helpers. CLI auto-registration stays off until you explicitly enable it.
localMcp.optInNote: `Claude Code` and `Codex` are opt-in. Stave only writes its managed MCP entry to your user-level CLI config files after you turn those settings on.

server.title: Server
server.description: Enable or disable the localhost MCP surface exposed by the desktop app.

port.title: Port
port.description: A fixed port keeps the endpoint stable across restarts, so clients that cached it keep working. Use `0` to let Stave choose any available localhost port instead.

claudeCode.description: Opt-in and off by default. When enabled, Stave manages only its own user-scope MCP entry in Claude Code's `.claude.json` (under `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, or `~/.claude.json`) for the external Claude Code app. This does not affect Stave's internal Claude runtime.

codex.description: Opt-in and off by default. When enabled, Stave manages only its own MCP entry in `~/.codex/config.toml` for Codex. Stave also injects the current token into the in-app Codex runtime env.

browserTools.title: Lens browser tools
browserTools.description: Expose the ~27 `stave_lens_*` browser tools to connected agents. Every tool schema is part of the prompt of each new provider session, so turning this off measurably shrinks the prompt for workspaces that never drive a browser from an agent turn.

token.title: Token
token.description: Bearer token required by local clients. Rotate it to immediately revoke previous access.

detail.loadFailed: Failed to load local MCP status.
detail.configuredNotRunning: Local MCP server is configured but not currently running.
detail.updateFailed: Failed to update local MCP settings.
detail.savedAndRestarted: Local MCP settings saved and server restarted.
detail.rotating: Generating a new local MCP token and restarting the server...
detail.rotateFailed: Failed to rotate local MCP token.
detail.rotated: Generated a new local MCP token and restarted the server.

requestLog.title: Local MCP Request Log
requestLog.description: Captures recent inbound requests to the embedded local MCP server.
requestLog.empty: No requests yet. Health checks are excluded, the latest page auto-refreshes while it stays open, and payloads load only when you expand a row.
requestLog.autoRefreshPaused: Auto-refresh is paused on older pages to keep pagination stable.

detail.apiUnavailable: Local MCP request log API unavailable.
detail.loadFailed: Failed to load local MCP request logs.
detail.clearFailed: Failed to clear local MCP request logs.
detail.none: No local MCP requests recorded yet.
detail.summaryLive_one: Showing {{start}}-{{end}} of {{count}} local MCP request (page {{page}} of {{totalPages}}). Auto-refresh is active on this page.
detail.summaryLive_other: Showing {{start}}-{{end}} of {{count}} local MCP requests (page {{page}} of {{totalPages}}). Auto-refresh is active on this page.
detail.summaryPaused_one: Showing {{start}}-{{end}} of {{count}} local MCP request (page {{page}} of {{totalPages}}). Auto-refresh pauses while browsing older pages.
detail.summaryPaused_other: Showing {{start}}-{{end}} of {{count}} local MCP requests (page {{page}} of {{totalPages}}). Auto-refresh pauses while browsing older pages.

payload.notRecorded: No payload recorded for this request.

general.label: General
general.description: Workspace defaults, notifications, and app behavior.

macros.label: Macros
macros.description: Reusable prompt snippets with optional model pins and instant run.

projects.label: Repositories
projects.description: Repository-level paths, setup prompts, and workspace defaults.

scripts.label: Workspace Tools
scripts.description: Long-running processes you leave up while developing, plus one-shot commands, lifecycle triggers, and environments.

chat.label: Chat
chat.description: Task mode, chat typography, streaming, reasoning, and active-turn behavior.

providers.label: Providers
providers.description: Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro provider runtime settings.

models.label: Models
models.description: Default model selection, visibility, and Utility AI provider.

autoRouting.label: Auto (Model Router)
autoRouting.description: How Auto sizes each turn: a level picks the model, your preference sets the effort.

codex.label: Codex Inspector
codex.description: Advanced App Server, plugin, thread, command, and config diagnostics.

mcp.label: MCP
mcp.description: Model Context Protocol servers and runtime status.

integrations.label: Integrations
integrations.description: Personal outbound connectors and external task sources.

issues.label: Issues
issues.description: Assigned ticket list defaults: starting view, refresh cadence, and how a kickoff begins.

kickoff.label: Kickoff
kickoff.description: External source matching and workspace proposal settings.

auxiliaryInference.label: Background AI
auxiliaryInference.description: Background model calls Stave makes on your behalf, and what each one costs.

prompts.label: Prompts
prompts.description: Default prompt text, response instructions, and review settings.

memory.label: Memory
memory.description: Repository memory collection, recall, templates, and reset controls.

skills.label: Skills
skills.description: Skill discovery and prompt input suggestions.

commandPalette.label: Command Palette
commandPalette.description: Global command launcher, shell shortcut chords, and model hotkeys.

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.description: Integrated terminal typography and cursor behavior.

editor.label: Editor
editor.description: Editor typography, display, and language tooling.

tooling.label: Tooling
tooling.description: Claude and Codex accounts, API connections, and local tool health checks.

lens.label: Lens
lens.description: Browser Lens sessions and visual comment capture.

secrets.label: Secrets
secrets.description: Encrypted API tokens and other secret values.

developer.label: Developer
developer.description: Developer diagnostics and internal runtime toggles.

autoRoutingEnabled.title: Enable Auto routing
autoRoutingEnabled.description: Global kill switch for the model router behind the composer's Auto option.

autoRoutingProfile.title: Auto routing profile
autoRoutingProfile.description: Routing levels, preference, allowed models, usage budget, signals, and rules the router reads.

accountUsageLimit.title: Stop turns at 100% usage
accountUsageLimit.description: When Claude, Codex, Cursor, or Kiro reports included account usage at 100%, block new turns and background AI for that provider so extra credits are not spent. Turns that are already running can still finish.

auxiliaryInference.title: Background AI
auxiliaryInference.description: Per-lane switch, provider, and model for the background calls Stave makes on your behalf: intent guard, turn summary, task naming, utility inference, PR description, pre-PR review, inline completion, and delegated tasks.

promptStyle.title: Prompt style
promptStyle.description: How you like prompts written: language, tone, detail level, and anything Enhance should always include or never add. Sent with every Enhance request when non-empty.

promptLearnFromEdits.title: Learn from kept and undone rewrites
promptLearnFromEdits.description: Remembers the last few Enhance results you kept or undid and shows them to the rewrite model as examples. Stored locally with your settings.

modelVisibility.title: Selector models
modelVisibility.description: Per-provider overrides for which catalog models the model selector lists by default.

craneConnector.title: Crane connector
craneConnector.description: Pair this Stave installation with your Crane account for locally approved, outbound-only task dispatch.

jiraConnector.title: Jira connector
jiraConnector.description: Read your assigned Jira Cloud issues over outbound HTTPS and map Jira projects to local Stave repositories.

trackerIssues.title: Issues
trackerIssues.description: Opens on tickets assigned to you. Choose which trackers Issues reads, the first tab, the refresh interval, and whether a kickoff starts immediately.

martinSync.title: Martin sync
martinSync.description: Push workspace events and resource links to a linked Martin project and pull its context snapshot.

claudeAccounts.title: Claude accounts
claudeAccounts.description: Keep more than one Claude sign-in, such as work and personal: add one, sign in, and choose the account new turns use.

codexAccounts.title: Codex accounts
codexAccounts.description: Keep more than one Codex sign-in, such as work and personal: add one, sign in, and choose the account new turns use.

apiConnections.title: API connections
apiConnections.description: Send Claude and Codex turns through a gateway such as Vercel AI Gateway with one key, billed per token instead of a subscription.

standaloneCliFolder.title: Standalone CLI folder

whole.delegationGuide: There is no button: delegation happens when an agent calls stave_delegate_task during its turn. Ask for it, for example “get a read-only second opinion on this plan from Codex at high effort”. Only the prompt is required. Omitted parameters follow this task’s provider, effort and permissions. The child runs one turn in this workspace; Settings has no global delegation defaults.
whole.delegationActivity: Once a delegation starts, its child appears in the task’s turn activity with Open, Follow-up, Stop, Detach and Retry controls.
whole.themeImport: Drop a <file>.theme.json</file> file to install a community theme. The JSON must include <id>id</id>, <name>name</name>, <mode>baseMode</mode>, and a <tokens>tokens</tokens> map.
whole.commandContributors: Use registerCommandPaletteContributor() to inject additional commands. Core Stave commands are customizable here; dynamic workspace/task entries and future contributed commands inherit the same execution surface automatically.
whole.lensHostScope: Enter a hostname or URL. Ports and paths are ignored, so <host>localhost</host> covers <portA>localhost:3000</portA>, <portB>localhost:8899</portB>, and other localhost ports.
whole.presetShortcuts: The first nine presets in the list below respond to <keys>Ctrl+1..9</keys> from top-to-bottom order.
whole.issueRefresh: Currently {{interval}}. Each refresh makes one request per connected tracker, so a short interval consumes rate limits. Accepted range is {{min}}–{{max}} seconds; values outside it are clamped.

messages.codexBrowserSetup: Enable chrome@openai-bundled and unified-computer-use@openai-bundled in the Codex CLI environment used by Stave, connect its Chrome extension, then try @web again.
messages.interactiveBrowser: Send an interactive prompt containing @web. Chrome access is attempted for that turn, and any failure is reported in the conversation. Site approval remains in the provider's extension; Stave cannot install, enable, or grant access on its behalf.
